questions.stem: Team X has median $45$ and IQR $12$. Team Y has median $48$ and IQR $30$. Which team is more consistent?

options.text: Team X, because it has a lower median
Team X, because it has a smaller IQR
Team Y, because it has a higher median
Team Y, because it has a larger IQR

questions.explanation: A smaller IQR indicates that the middle $50\%$ of the data is closer together, meaning Team X's results are more consistent (less spread out).
